name: Fiberon PET-GF15 @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.6 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 250 mm/s.
All-metal hotend, hardened nozzle (brass life ~9 h). Fan OFF. TDS chamber: room temp; wiki FAQ: prints on open-frame but enclosed/heated-chamber printer recommended for best results. Moisture sensitive, store <20% RH. Sold in 1 kg (6 colors) and 3 kg spools (no 500 g). Prints may stick hard to clean textured PEI - let plate cool. Possible slight surface discoloration from crystallinity differences.
Source: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0548/7299/7945/files/TDS_FIBERON_PET-GF15_Compressed-compressed.pdf
